warframes.name: Ash
warframes.description: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
warframes.passive: <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects inflicted on enemies do |DAMAGE|% increased damage and last |DURATION|% longer.

warframes.name: Atlas
warframes.description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
warframes.passive: Becomes immune to Knockdown effects while on the ground.

warframes.name: Banshee
warframes.description: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
warframes.passive: Weapon noises are hushed so that enemies cannot hear them.

warframes.name: Baruuk
warframes.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
warframes.passive: Each projectile dodged, each enemy lulled or disarmed, erodes Baruuk's restraint and fuels the storm within. As Baruuk's restraint is diminished he becomes up to |PERCENT|% more resistant to damage.

warframes.name: Caliban
warframes.description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
warframes.passive: Allies within Affinity range gain up to |PCT|% resistance to the types of damage they are currently taking.

warframes.name: Chroma
warframes.description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
warframes.passive: Wings sprout for an additional jump and bullet jump.

warframes.name: Citrine
warframes.description: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
warframes.passive: Citrine grants nearby allies |BASE| health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by |HPS|, up to a maximum of |MAX|.

warframes.name: Cyte-09
warframes.description: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
warframes.passive: Weak Point Kills increase Cyte-09's Weak Point Critical Chance by |INCREASE|% up to |CAP|% for the duration of the current mission.

warframes.name: Dagath
warframes.description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
warframes.passive: There is a |PERCENT|% chance that Energy and Health Orbs will be |ENERGY|% more effective on Dagath.

warframes.name: Dante
warframes.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
warframes.passive: Noctua scans targets, recording information for your Codex. Status Chance increases by |CHANCE|% on fully scanned targets.

warframes.name: Ember
warframes.description: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
warframes.passive: Receive |STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for every enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range affected by <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

warframes.name: Equinox
warframes.description: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
warframes.passive: |PERCENT|% of Health Orbs are converted into Energy, and |PERCENT|% of Energy Orbs are converted into Health.

warframes.name: Excalibur
warframes.description: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
warframes.passive: Excalibur deals |DAMAGE|% increased damage and attacks |SPEED|% faster when wielding swords.

warframes.name: Frost
warframes.description: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost’s attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
warframes.passive: Cold Status Effects from Frost's Abilities last |DURATION|% longer. Frost gains |ARMOR| Armor for each enemy afflicted with <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.

warframes.name: Gara
warframes.description: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
warframes.passive: A chance to create a radial blind lasting |DURATION|s when Gara casts Abilities.

warframes.name: Garuda
warframes.description: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
warframes.passive:
Garuda's damage temporarily increases with each enemy she kills, to a maximum of |DAMAGE|%. 
Slashes with her talons if no melee weapon is equipped.

warframes.name: Gauss
warframes.description: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
warframes.passive: Moving generates an electrical current that fills Gauss' battery. Shields recharge up to |SPEED|% faster while the Recharge Delay is up to |DELAY|% shorter, based on the battery level.

warframes.name: Grendel
warframes.description: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
warframes.passive: Each enemy consumed grants |ARMOUR| bonus armor.

warframes.name: Gyre
warframes.description: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
warframes.passive: Gyre's abilities have a 10% chance to deal critical damage for each Electrical status that affects the enemy.

warframes.name: Harrow
warframes.description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
warframes.passive:
Overshield capacity doubled.
Start missions at maximum energy.

warframes.name: Hildryn
warframes.description: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
warframes.passive: Hildryn's full Shield Gate is high. After her Shields are depleted, she is invulnerable to damage up to 3.5s.

warframes.name: Hydroid
warframes.description: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
warframes.passive: Enemies damaged by Hydroid are more vulnerable to <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Status, with initial Status reducing Armor by |PCT|%.

warframes.name: Inaros
warframes.description: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
warframes.passive: When Inaros takes lethal damage, he entombs himself in a sarcophagus and incarnates as sand to attack enemies, draining their lifeforce to revive himself.

warframes.name: Ivara
warframes.description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
warframes.passive: Senses nearby enemies within |RADIUS|m.

warframes.name: Jade
warframes.description: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
warframes.passive: Jade's profound understanding of the relationship between life and death grants her two Aura Mod Slots. Some of her Abilities apply Judgments, increasing enemy damage vulnerability by |CHANCE|% for |DURATION|s.

warframes.name: Khora
warframes.description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
warframes.passive: The ferocious kavat, Venari, fights by Khora's side and provides her with a |SPEED|% speed boost while active. If killed, Venari will reappear after |RESPAWN|s.

warframes.name: Koumei
warframes.description: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
warframes.passive: Every |DURATION| seconds, one of Koumei's weapons will inflict random Status Effects for |DURATION| seconds.

warframes.name: Kullervo
warframes.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
warframes.passive: Kullervo boasts +|EFFICIENCY|% Heavy Attack Efficiency and +|WINDUP|% Heavy Attack Wind Up Speed on all melee weapons.

warframes.name: Lavos
warframes.description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
warframes.passive:
Energy and Universal Orbs give Lavos status immunity for |DURATION|s.

Hold any ability to imbue the next cast with additional Elemental Damage and Status.

warframes.name: Limbo
warframes.description: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
warframes.passive: Dodge to enter and exit the Rift. Entering leaves behind a small Rift portal lasting |DURATION|s. Energy slowly recharges in the Rift, and each enemy killed in there also gives |ENERGY| Energy.

warframes.name: Loki
warframes.description: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
warframes.passive: Able to hang from walls |MULT|x longer than normal.

warframes.name: Mag
warframes.description: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
warframes.passive: Nearby items gravitate toward Mag for easy collection.

warframes.name: Mesa
warframes.description: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
warframes.passive: Shoot dual-wielded sidearms |SPEED|% faster and reload single-handed sidearms |RELOAD|% more rapidly. Gain |HEALTH| Bonus Health when not using Melee Weapons.

warframes.name: Mirage
warframes.description: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
warframes.passive: Sliding lasts |DURATION|% longer and acrobatic maneuvers are |SPEED|% faster.

warframes.name: Nekros
warframes.description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
warframes.passive: Restore |HEALTH| Health with every enemy death within |RADIUS|m.

warframes.name: Nezha
warframes.description: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
warframes.passive: Slide |SPEED|% faster and go |RANGE|% farther.

warframes.name: Nidus
warframes.description: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
warframes.passive: If Nidus is killed with at least |STACKS| stacks of Mutation, those |STACKS| stacks are consumed; this grants |DURATION|s of invulnerability and restores Health to |HEAL|%.

warframes.name: Nokko
warframes.description: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
warframes.passive: Upon receiving fatal damage, Nokko reverts to his Sprodling form and his active mushrooms will glow, reviving Nokko when touched. Orbs spawned will grant a speed boost but not healing. If a glowing mushroom is not reached in time, Nokko will automatically use a self-revive.

warframes.name: Nova
warframes.description: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
warframes.passive: Enemies killed while slowed down have |CHANCE|% to drop health orbs. Enemies killed while sped up have |CHANCE|% to drop energy orbs.

warframes.name: Nyx
warframes.description: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
warframes.passive: Nyx gains +|CRITICAL|% Critical Chance on Primary and Secondary weapons per Confused enemy within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range, up to +|MAX|%.

warframes.name: Oberon
warframes.description: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
warframes.passive: Oberon grants Righteous Negation to himself and his allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range when he collects <HEALTH>Health Orbs, protecting players against the next instance of damage. Stacks up to |STACKS| times.

warframes.name: Octavia
warframes.description: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
warframes.passive: Replenish |ENERGY| energy over |DURATION|s for Octavia and allies within |RANGE|m when abilities are activated.

warframes.name: Oraxia
warframes.description: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
warframes.passive: Wall Latching grants Predator's Lurk, rendering Oraxia invisible for |DURATION|s.

warframes.name: Orion & Sirius
warframes.description: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
warframes.passive:
Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.

warframes.name: Protea
warframes.description: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
warframes.passive: Every |CASTS|th Power Cast is granted +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength.

warframes.name: Qorvex
warframes.description: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
warframes.passive: Weapons wielded by Qorvex have an additional +|PUNCH_THROUGH| Punch Through.

warframes.name: Revenant
warframes.description: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
warframes.passive: Shield depletion smashes enemies within |RADIUS|m with a |DAMAGE| Damage knockdown shockwave.

warframes.name: Rhino
warframes.description: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
warframes.passive: Emit a shockwave dealing |DAMAGE| damage after landing from a great height.

warframes.name: Saryn
warframes.description: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
warframes.passive: Status Effects inflicted upon enemies last |DURATION|% longer.

warframes.name: Sevagoth
warframes.description: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
warframes.passive: On death, become Sevagoth's Shadow and fight to resurrect him by collecting the souls needed to rebuild his tombstone.

warframes.name: Sirius & Orion
warframes.description: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
warframes.passive:
Swapping between them grants |EFFICIENCY|% Ability Efficiency for the next |COUNT| casts.

When below 50 energy, Sirius & Orion will steal energy from each other.

warframes.name: Styanax
warframes.description: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
warframes.passive: Styanax's critical chance increases with his shields and doubles for spearguns.

warframes.name: Temple
warframes.description: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
warframes.passive: Play abilities in sync with the Backbeat metronome to invigorate ability effects while increasing Ability Efficiency by |COST|%.

warframes.name: Titania
warframes.description: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
warframes.passive: Titania generates Health for herself and nearby allies every time she casts an Ability.

warframes.name: Trinity
warframes.description: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
warframes.passive: Allies in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range gain |BUFF|% of Trinity's Max Energy as Health.

warframes.name: Uriel
warframes.description: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
warframes.passive:
Uriel commands, empowers, and protects three unique demons.

CATENACH: Snares and slows enemies chaining them together. Damage dealt to any target in the chain is inflicted on all snared enemies. (Unlocks with Infernalis)

GULPHAGOR : Latches onto foes dealing damage over time. If killed, a circle of pain is spawned. (Unlocks with Remedium)

VYTHELAS: Inscribes demonic runes upon fallen foes that add Fire Rate and <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Damage when collected. (Unlocks with Demonium)

warframes.name: Valkyr
warframes.description: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
warframes.passive: Valkyr accumulates Rage when hitting or killing enemies with melee weapons, increasing her Melee Damage up to |PERCENT|%. Taking fatal damage when the Rage meter is above |CONSUME|% consumes the meter, preventing death and granting |DURATION|s of invulnerability.

warframes.name: Vauban
warframes.description: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
warframes.passive: Deal x|DAMAGE| Damage to incapacitated enemies.

warframes.name: Volt
warframes.description: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
warframes.passive: Grounded movement generates an electrical charge building up |DAMAGE| Damage per meter that is unleashed with the next attack.

warframes.name: Voruna
warframes.description: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
warframes.passive: Voruna never fights alone. In mission, hold Abilities to call upon each wolf’s unique Passive power.

warframes.name: Wisp
warframes.description: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
warframes.passive: Flowing between dimensions, Wisp becomes invisible to enemies while in the air.

warframes.name: Wukong
warframes.description: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
warframes.passive: After taking fatal damage Wukong automatically uses one of his mastered survival techniques. These techniques can only be invoked three times per mission.

warframes.name: Xaku
warframes.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
warframes.passive: |CHANCE|% Damage Reduction on AOE attacks and chance to avoid incoming weapon damage.

warframes.name: Yareli
warframes.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
warframes.passive: Yareli gains +|CHANCE|% Critical Chance for Secondary weapons when she has been moving for at least |TIME|s.

warframes.name: Zephyr
warframes.description: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
warframes.passive: Zephyr moves faster and falls slower while airborne. Also gain |CRIT|% Critical Hit chance with weapons while airborne.

primary.name: Acceltra
primary.description: Using a barrage of rapid-fire plasma rockets, Gauss’ signature weapon lays down a path of destruction. Reloads are faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. For safety, rockets arm after traveling a safe distance.

primary.name: Aeolak
primary.description: This unusual automatic rifle feels strangely familiar and has two fire modes. Primary fire packs radiation damage. Alternate fire charges up to launch an explosive projectile.

primary.name: Afentis
primary.description: Styanax’s speargun matches his might. Throw Afentis to pin an enemy and nearby enemies will also be stunned. Throw Afentis onto the ground to buff nearby allies with Ballistarii Might. The buff increases reload speed, fire rate, and ammo pools and reduces recoil. Allies who kill enemies with Ballistarii Might maintain the buff temporarily when they move away from Afentis.

primary.name: Alternox
primary.description: Gyre's signature weapon has two fire modes. Primary fire shocks enemies with electrical orbs. Alternate fire is a large ball of electricity that sticks to any surface and pulses <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity before it explodes. In Gyre's hands, the weapon has a small amount of multishot.

primary.name: Ambassador
primary.description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.

primary.name: Amprex
primary.description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.

primary.name: Arca Plasmor
primary.description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.

primary.name: Argonak
primary.description: Pick off targets by highlighting distant enemies using this Grineer rifle's advanced laser sighting system. Deadly in both single fire and automatic modes.

primary.name: Astilla
primary.description: Blast enemies with glass slugs that devastate on impact. In Gara's hands, this signature weapon has a larger Ammo Pool.

primary.name: Attica
primary.description: Quickly fire off a volley of deadly bolts with the Attica repeating crossbow.

primary.name: Ax-52
primary.description: This pre-Orokin weapon earned its popularity for its reliability in tough conditions. When hip-firing, its Ammo Efficiency increases. When aiming, headshots have a high Critical Chance.

primary.name: Basmu
primary.description: This Sentient war instrument can either barrage targets with explosive bolts or draw on its regenerative battery to create twin plasma beams that chain through targets. When fully drained, Health is leeched from nearby foes for a short period.

primary.name: Battacor
primary.description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.

primary.name: Baza
primary.description: Make easy prey of enemies with this quiet, agile, and pinpoint accurate Tenno submachine gun.

primary.name: Boar
primary.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.

primary.name: Boltor
primary.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

primary.name: Braton
primary.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.

primary.name: Bubonico
primary.description: Rain down a triple volley of explosive disease bladders from a distance, then move in for the kill by unloading a multi-shot barrage of toxic barbs with primary fire.

primary.name: Burston
primary.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.

primary.name: Buzlok
primary.description: Mark your targets and unleash a barrage of bullets, the Buzlok's homing rounds always find the enemy. Marked targets are more likely to take critical hits.

primary.name: Cedo
primary.description: Launch a glaive that ricochets off surfaces in bursts of elemental damage, then perforate enemies with primary fire’s precision buck-shot. Damage increases with each Status Effect afflicting a target. Lavos will transmute a small portion of any ammo pickup to Primary Ammo when wielding his signature Cedo.

primary.name: Cernos
primary.description: Evoking the design of ancient bows, the high impact Cernos is perfect for hunting down highly shielded enemies.

primary.name: Cinta
primary.description: The versatile Cinta can fire arrows in quick succession, quickly charge a shock wave, or fully charge a powerful focused shot.

primary.name: Coda Bassocyst
primary.description: Amplify shockwaves of devastating sound with this Technocyte virus infested shotgun that hungers for blood, and desires nothing more than to feed upon its enemies. Alternative fire at enemies not vulnerable to Mercy Kills to swarm them with infested mites, while firing at vulnerable ones will perform a ranged execution.

primary.name: Convectrix
primary.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.

primary.name: Corinth
primary.description: Deliver a massive punch with each blast of this shotgun, or launch a round that explodes mid-air knocking down nearby enemies.

primary.name: Daikyu
primary.description: Daikyu takes great strength to draw back, but provides added power and range to every shot.

primary.name: Dera
primary.description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.

primary.name: Drakgoon
primary.description: The Drakgoon flak cannon sends volleys of intensely hot shrapnel ricocheting around the room. Can be fired in wide or concentrated bursts.

primary.name: Dread
primary.description: Dread is the calling card of The Stalker. It fires arrows that can decapitate.

primary.name: Efv-5 Jupiter
primary.description: Perforate Techrot, and anyone else who stands in your way, with this Scaldra machine gun. Alternative fire pummels targets with Efervon laced buckshot.

primary.name: Enkaus
primary.description: Turn the enemy's worst nightmare into reality with Follie's signature rifle. The Enkaus will instantly kill and dissolve inked enemies that are damaged at low health. Shooting inked enemies siphons ink back into the Enkaus, allowing for a constant flow of creative destruction.

primary.name: Evensong
primary.description:
Counter the dread of battle with a song of praise. Enemies cannot hurt your allies while wounded by Evensong's arrows. Kills with Evensong empower ally weapons with Multishot.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

primary.name: Exergis
primary.description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.

primary.name: Felarx
primary.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.

primary.name: Ferrox
primary.description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.

primary.name: Flux Rifle
primary.description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.

primary.name: Fulmin
primary.description: Strike with silent lightning or the pummeling drum of thunder. Alternate between stealthy short-range electrical discharge, and automatic lightning gun. Faster mode-switch when used by Wisp.

primary.name: Glaxion
primary.description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.

primary.name: Gorgon
primary.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.

primary.name: Grakata
primary.description: Equipped with a huge Magazine and impressive Fire Rate, the Grakata is the preferred weapon of Grineer Lancers.

primary.name: Grinlok
primary.description: With pinpoint accuracy, the Grinlok lever-action repeating rifle can easily find the soft spot on any target.

primary.name: Haalvu
primary.description: Deliver a ruthless barrage of Sentient artillery from this instrument of death. Alt-fire splits the weapon apart into separate rifles, expanding its devastation by tracking up to 4 targets at once, while consuming more ammo per shot.

primary.name: Harpak
primary.description: Spike enemies to the wall or reel them in with this burst harpoon gun.

primary.name: Hek
primary.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.

primary.name: Hema
primary.description: A bloodsucker. This symbiotic burst-rifle leeches health to forge its ammo and then restores health with each headshot.

primary.name: Higasa
primary.description: Depend on Higasa when it rains bullets. Aiming creates a shield that blocks weapon fire. Kills and blocked shots charge a beam released by Alternate Fire.

primary.name: Hind
primary.description: A powerful mid-range rifle used by Grineer shock troops, the Hind fires in five round bursts.

primary.name: Ignis
primary.description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.

primary.name: Javlok
primary.description: Launch super-heated slugs at individual foes, or hurl the entire weapon and ignite groups of enemies in a flash inferno.

primary.name: Karak
primary.description: Solid, dependable and deadly. The Karak is a standard issue rifle in many Grineer platoons.

primary.name: Kohm
primary.description: For every shot fired in rapid succession the Kohm releases an additional bolt and grows more lethal.

primary.name: Komorex
primary.description: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.

primary.name: Lanka
primary.description: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.

primary.name: Latron
primary.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.

primary.name: Lenz
primary.description:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.

primary.name: Miter
primary.description: The Miter launches high velocity saw blades, tearing apart anyone unfortunate enough to be in their path.

primary.name: Nagantaka
primary.description: Slash targets with a single precise bolt from Garuda's signature crossbow. Alt-fire to let loose a barrage of bolts. All bolts have a chance to cause <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status, and Headshots have a chance to increase Reload Speed. When wielded by Garuda Nagantaka gains a slight Punch Through.

primary.name: Nataruk
primary.description: Hunhow’s gift, carved from the bones of his kin. Shots can be charged and held; release them just before full charge for maximum effect.

primary.name: Ogris
primary.description: Ogris fires detonite-infused casings.

primary.name: Opticor
primary.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.

primary.name: Panthera
primary.description: Firing high-velocity blades, this weapon can also be used as a battle-saw, shredding anything unfortunate enough to get within range.

primary.name: Paracyst
primary.description: Completely overwhelmed by Infested biology, this former Quanta now fires organic ordnance and a harpoon like appendage.

primary.name: Paris
primary.description: Based on one of the world's oldest weapon designs, this Tenno-crafted weapon can be used both in stealth and in open combat. The Paris uses a chargeable magnetic field to launch arrows capable of impaling enemies to walls.

primary.name: Penta
primary.description: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.

primary.name: Perigale
primary.description: Like a breath of wind, shots fired by this multi-barrel sniper are felt but never seen by its targets. Headshots in quick succession increase the Perigale's ammo efficiency. When the Perigale is wielded by Voruna, its ammo pool increases.

primary.name: Phage
primary.description: Fires seven beams of continuous biochemical energy which depletes the life of any surface they contact.

primary.name: Phantasma
primary.description: Irradiate enemies with a continuous stream of deadly plasma. Charging secondary fire releases a glob of plasma that erupts with homing bomblets on impact. Increased Magazine Capacity when wielded by Revenant.

primary.name: Phenmor
primary.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.

primary.name: Proboscis Cernos
primary.description: Each arrow spawns a swarm of sticky appendages on impact. These tongue-like probes latch onto nearby unfortunates and drag them close before bursting into a mess of diseased goo.

primary.name: Purgator 1
primary.description: Put them down so that they stay down, with this Scaldra slug launcher.

primary.name: Quanta
primary.description: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.

primary.name: Quartakk
primary.description: Annihilate targets with four simultaneous shots from this high-caliber Grineer rifle.

primary.name: Quellor
primary.description: The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts.

primary.name: Rauta
primary.description: Kullervo's signature weapon boasts melee synergy. Every shot that lands increases the wielder's Melee Combo count. When Kullervo wields Rauta, it also increases his Melee Combo duration.

primary.name: Reconifex
primary.description: Cyte-09's signature rifle is an ideal match for forceful gunners. A precisely timed reload increases reload speed and infuses the new magazine with Heat Damage.

primary.name: Rubico
primary.description: Scope out the enemy with this long-range revolver style rifle.

primary.name: Scourge
primary.description: Blast targets with corrosive plasma projectiles, or toss the scepter to inflict an energy field upon nearby enemies that amplifies their brain waves to attract bullets.

primary.name: Shedu
primary.description: This arm-cannon, ripped from a Sentient, rapid-fires thermal pulses that explode in an electrical blast. Features an ammo-less quick charge capacitor, that emits a knock-back pulse and strips Sentient damage resistances when fully discharged.

primary.name: Simulor
primary.description: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.

primary.name: Snipetron
primary.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.

primary.name: Sobek
primary.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.

primary.name: Soma
primary.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.

primary.name: Sporothrix
primary.description: This long-distance rifle fires a razor-sharp, virus-soaked barb that continues to attack its host before violently erupting in a spore-laden mist. Scoped headshots increase lethality.

primary.name: Stahlta
primary.description: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.

primary.name: Steflos
primary.description: An energy projectile bursts forth from the Steflos and grows as it rushes toward enemies. The projectile's duration increases when it hits an enemy. When Citrine fires the Steflos, its projectile speed increases.

primary.name: Stradavar
primary.description: A high-capacity, high-damage enforcer, this weapon can switch between the high crit semi-automatic and full automatic firing modes.

primary.name: Strun
primary.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.

primary.name: Supra
primary.description: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.

primary.name: Sybaris
primary.description: This Tenno crafted, lever action rifle, is equal parts elegance and executioner.

primary.name: Synapse
primary.description: Powered by a bio-chemical reaction, the Infested Synapse rifle fries its targets with a steady stream of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive energy.

primary.name: Tenora
primary.description: Unload percussive machine gun fire, or strike a heavy chord with a single charge shot. When Octavia wields her signature rifle alt-fire Headshot Kills have a chance to instantly refill the magazine.

primary.name: Tetra
primary.description: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.

primary.name: Thornbak
primary.description: A sturdy burst-rifle of considerable age and unknown origin collected by Teshin during his many years wandering the Origin System.

primary.name: Tiberon
primary.description: Forged by a master gunsmith, this Tenno burst rifle will strike down targets with swift precision.

primary.name: Tigris
primary.description: The double-barreled Tigris shotgun fires two bursts in rapid succession, easily taking down the toughest prey.

primary.name: Tonkor
primary.description: Hurl mayhem and destruction with this Grineer grenade launcher.

primary.name: Torid
primary.description: Torid lobs a toxic payload.

primary.name: Trumna
primary.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.

primary.name: Vaykor Hek
primary.description: Forged in the fires of rebel struggle, this shotgun is a force for liberation.

primary.name: Vectis
primary.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.

primary.name: Veldt
primary.description: Precise calibration, rapid trigger-pull and a steady hand all combine to bring down the hardiest prey on two legs or four.

primary.name: Vinquibus
primary.description: Bring hell to the battlefield with Uriel's signature rifle and bayonet combination. Occupying both primary and melee slots, this unique weapon blends precision marksmanship with unrelenting melee combat.

primary.name: Vulkar
primary.description: Built by the Grineer for their elite troopers, the Vulkar is a devastating distance weapon. In the right hands it is capable of taking down targets long before they get into attack range.

primary.name: Zarr
primary.description: Unload a barrage of explosives or a huge shot of flak from this cannon’s enormous barrel.

primary.name: Zenith
primary.description: Deploy the radar disc to reveal hidden enemies and then strike with precision shots that punch through all obstacles in the way.

primary.name: Zhuge
primary.description: This devastating automatic crossbow is the perfect marriage of ancient Earth weaponry and Tenno technology.

secondary.name: Acrid
secondary.description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.

secondary.name: Aegrit
secondary.description: What the Aegrit lacks in quantity it makes up for in destructive power. Toss the Aegrit onto your enemy’s position then detonate remotely at the right moment for maximum destructive effect.

secondary.name: Afuris
secondary.description: Furis pistols equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but Accuracy and Reload Speed are lowered.

secondary.name: Akarius
secondary.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.

secondary.name: Akbolto
secondary.description: A Bolto equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and slightly faster Fire Rate, but reload time is doubled and accuracy is lowered.

secondary.name: Akbronco
secondary.description: A Bronco equipped in each hand.

secondary.name: Akjagara
secondary.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.

secondary.name: Aklato
secondary.description: A Lato equipped in each hand. Twice the Magazine Capacity and Fire Rate, but Reload time is doubled and Accuracy is lowered.

secondary.name: Aklex
secondary.description: Dual Lex pistols double the amount of high caliber lead you can throw at the enemy, but accuracy and reload time suffer.

secondary.name: Akmagnus
secondary.description: Twice the ammo and twice the stopping power of a single Magnus.

secondary.name: Aksomati
secondary.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.

secondary.name: Akstiletto
secondary.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.

secondary.name: Akvasto
secondary.description: Vasto revolvers equipped in each hand.

secondary.name: Akzani
secondary.description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.

secondary.name: Angstrum
secondary.description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.

secondary.name: Arca Scisco
secondary.description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.

secondary.name: Athodai
secondary.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.

secondary.name: Atomos
secondary.description: This particle cannon generates a condensed beam of super-heated plasma designed to melt rock to ore, and enemies to molten slag.

secondary.name: Azima
secondary.description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.

secondary.name: Ballistica
secondary.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.

secondary.name: Bolto
secondary.description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.

secondary.name: Brakk
secondary.description: Simple but powerful. The semi-automatic Brakk hand cannon delivers a lot of punch in a small package.

secondary.name: Bronco
secondary.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.

secondary.name: Cantare
secondary.description:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

secondary.name: Castanas
secondary.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.

secondary.name: Catabolyst
secondary.description: Splatter enemies with a short-range stream of corrosive bile and then toss the ammo bladder as a grenade when reloading. The emptier the pistol’s ammo bladder, the more potent its damage. A fully empty bladder packs the biggest punch.

secondary.name: Cestra
secondary.description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.

secondary.name: Cyanex
secondary.description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.

secondary.name: Cycron
secondary.description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.

secondary.name: Despair
secondary.description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.

secondary.name: Detron
secondary.description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.

secondary.name: Dual Cestra
secondary.description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.

secondary.name: Dual Coda Torxica
secondary.description: Get the job done right with a pair of spore flinging terror tools. Inflicts a spore that spreads to nearby enemies on death causing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status Effect and increased vulnerability to damage from the Torxica.

secondary.name: Dual Toxocyst
secondary.description: Brain-strikes excite this bioweapon, causing it to rapidly release toxic munitions.

secondary.name: Efv-8 Mars
secondary.description: The standard issue personal Efervon projector, as sported by all ranks of Scaldra.

secondary.name: Embolist
secondary.description: A living weapon, the infested Embolist pistol kills its victims with an acidic venomous gas.

secondary.name: Epitaph
secondary.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.

secondary.name: Furis
secondary.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.

secondary.name: Fusilai
secondary.description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.

secondary.name: Gammacor
secondary.description: Designed to quickly vaporize minerals for content analysis, users discovered its powerful beam was equally efficient at dispatching hostiles.

secondary.name: Grimoire
secondary.description: Claim the power of Albrecht Entrati's knowledge. Customize the Grimoire with Tome Mods that enhance Warframe Abilities and reward strategic combat. Its alternate attack releases a voltaic orb with guaranteed <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.

secondary.name: Hikou
secondary.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.

secondary.name: Hystrix
secondary.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.

secondary.name: Knell
secondary.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.

secondary.name: Kohmak
secondary.description: Like the larger Kohm, this hand-shotgun doubles its volley with each successive shot.

secondary.name: Kompressa
secondary.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.

secondary.name: Kraken
secondary.description: The Kraken is a heavy pistol of Grineer design that fires two quick shots with a single pull of the trigger. Skilled marksmen will appreciate the value in this deadly accurate weapon.

secondary.name: Kulstar
secondary.description: Rain hell on the enemy with this handheld cluster-rocket launcher.

secondary.name: Kunai
secondary.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.

secondary.name: Laetum
secondary.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.

secondary.name: Lato
secondary.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.

secondary.name: Lex
secondary.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.

secondary.name: Magnus
secondary.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.

secondary.name: Marelok
secondary.description: The Marelok combines the stopping power of a rifle with the portability of a pistol.

secondary.name: Nukor
secondary.description: Creates and focuses a high-frequency field of microwaves, literally cooking the target from within.

secondary.name: Ocucor
secondary.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.

secondary.name: Onos
secondary.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.

secondary.name: Pandero
secondary.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.

secondary.name: Plinx
secondary.description: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.

secondary.name: Pox
secondary.description: These festering sacs of pus and gas burst violently on impact.

secondary.name: Pyrana
secondary.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.

secondary.name: Quatz
secondary.description: A compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.

secondary.name: Riot-848
secondary.description: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.

secondary.name: Scyotid
secondary.description: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.

secondary.name: Seer
secondary.description: Captain Vor's prized Orokin-Grineer hybrid pistol has an average rate of fire, but it has high damage and superior zoom capabilities.

secondary.name: Sepulcrum
secondary.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.

secondary.name: Sicarus
secondary.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.

secondary.name: Sonicor
secondary.description: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.

secondary.name: Spectra
secondary.description: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.

secondary.name: Spira
secondary.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.

secondary.name: Staticor
secondary.description: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.

secondary.name: Stubba
secondary.description: Inflict rapid-fire bursts of pain with this Grineer submachine gun.

secondary.name: Stug
secondary.description: Firing a sticky, toxic, explosive compound, the Stug Gel Gun offers multiple ejection modes, delivering maximum damage in all situations.

secondary.name: Talons
secondary.description: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.

secondary.name: Twin Grakatas
secondary.description: When one Grakata isn't enough, bring another for extra firepower.

secondary.name: Twin Gremlins
secondary.description: Designed as a pair, these Grineer sidearms fire projectiles at a slower rate but with greater force and accuracy.

secondary.name: Twin Kohmak
secondary.description: Doubling their volley on each successive shot, the Twin Kohmaks decimate foes in seconds.

secondary.name: Twin Rogga
secondary.description: These twin barrels of destruction are the signature pistols of the Kuva Guardians.

secondary.name: Twin Vipers
secondary.description: A Viper equipped in each hand.

secondary.name: Tysis
secondary.description: The Tysis pistol spits out caustic darts that corrode their victims from within.

secondary.name: Vasto
secondary.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.

secondary.name: Vaykor Marelok
secondary.description: Taken from defeated Grineer commanders and rebuilt to improve combat efficiency and reliability.

secondary.name: Velox
secondary.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.

secondary.name: Vesper 77
secondary.description: A true masterpiece of Höllvanian engineering, Vesper 77's advanced laser sight highlights enemy Weak Points with precision. Aim to increase its Critical Damage Multiplier.

secondary.name: Viper
secondary.description: A full-auto pistol known as the most compact and lightweight weapon of the Grineer arsenal. Though it has a small Magazine Capacity, the Viper has a very high Fire Rate and ultra-fast reload times thanks to a simplified magazine design.

secondary.name: Zakti
secondary.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.

secondary.name: Zylok
secondary.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.

secondary.name: Zymos
secondary.description: Infect your foes with this spore-scattering pistol. Headshots burrow in and explode, releasing spore clouds that seek out nearby enemies.

melee.name: Ack & Brunt
melee.description: Tyl Regor's custom axe and shield are how he likes to eliminate ‘frustrations'.

melee.name: Amanata
melee.description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.

melee.name: Amphis
melee.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.

melee.name: Anku
melee.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.

melee.name: Ankyros
melee.description: A pair of mighty gauntlets, the Ankyros were designed by the Tenno for close quarters combat. What they lack in range they make up for in speed.

melee.name: Arca Titron
melee.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.

melee.name: Argo & Vel
melee.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.

melee.name: Arum Spinosa
melee.description: Slash through enemies with two leaves of the exceedingly rare Arum Spinosa plant. Heavy Attack to whip a flurry of toxic spines at ranged attackers.

melee.name: Atterax
melee.description: A multi-bladed whip that is adept at flaying skin from bone. In extreme cases, disobedient Grineer are sentenced to death by Atterax.

melee.name: Azothane
melee.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.

melee.name: Bo
melee.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.

melee.name: Boltace
melee.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.

melee.name: Broken Scepter
melee.description: A shattered talisman of the Grineer Elder Queen. It pulls health orbs from deceased enemies and energy orbs from destroyed robots.

melee.name: Broken War
melee.description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.

melee.name: Cadus
melee.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.

melee.name: Cassowar
melee.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.

melee.name: Caustacyst
melee.description: Heavy attacks from this scythe unleash a wave of acid that mutilates enemies and leaves a trail of corrosive sludge.

melee.name: Ceramic Dagger
melee.description: This short blade weapon was built using ceramic. It has limited range but comes out fast.

melee.name: Cerata
melee.description: Twisted and tortured from exposure to the Infestation, this glaive becomes an absolute predator in the hands of the right Tenno.

melee.name: Cobra & Crane
melee.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.

melee.name: Coda Motovore
melee.description: Drive home the pain with this hammer evolved from a scooter assembly. The wheel shapeshifts and gains a unique buff to match whatever type of physical damage it has been modded for.

melee.name: Corufell
melee.description: Heavy attacks briefly transform the Corufell into a Gunblade. After the Gunblade fires, the Corufell returns to its Heavy Scythe state. Its transformation is fastest in Citrine's hands.

melee.name: Cronus
melee.description: A strong blade forged using ceramic.

melee.name: Dark Dagger
melee.description: This short blade weapon forged using dark metals has limited range but comes out fast.

melee.name: Dark Split-Sword
melee.description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.

melee.name: Dark Sword
melee.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.

melee.name: Destreza
melee.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.

melee.name: Dorrclave
melee.description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.

melee.name: Dual Cleavers
melee.description: Butcher your foes with brutal blades in each hand.

melee.name: Dual Ether
melee.description: Fast and precise. The Dual Ether cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies. Capable of hitting multiple targets.

melee.name: Dual Heat Swords
melee.description: With a Heat Sword in each hand, enemies reach their fiery demise twice as fast. Can connect with multiple targets at once.

melee.name: Dual Ichor
melee.description: The fast and brutal Dual Ichor axes will quickly tear through enemies with a high probability of inflicting Critical Damage.

melee.name: Dual Kamas
melee.description: Wielding a Kama in each hand brings a savage amount of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to bear against your enemies.

melee.name: Dual Keres
melee.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.

melee.name: Dual Raza
melee.description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.

melee.name: Dual Skana
melee.description: A shorter Skana in each hand. Can hit multiple targets.

melee.name: Dual Viciss
melee.description: Reap what the Techrot have sown with this vicious pair of Scaldra hand-scythes.

melee.name: Dual Zoren
melee.description: Short axes held in each hand. High attack speed and can hit multiple targets. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

melee.name: Edun
melee.description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.

melee.name: Ekhein
melee.description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.

melee.name: Endura
melee.description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.

melee.name: Ether Daggers
melee.description: A shorter version of the Ether blade that allows for a more focused attack on a single target.

melee.name: Ether Reaper
melee.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.

melee.name: Ether Sword
melee.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.

melee.name: Falcor
melee.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.

melee.name: Fang
melee.description: These matching stilettos have increased attack speed and can unleash a flurry of multi-hit attacks.

melee.name: Fragor
melee.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.

melee.name: Furax
melee.description: These power gauntlets lack the range of most Melee Weapons, but Furax is far more devastating when you strike an enemy in close combat.

melee.name: Galatine
melee.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.

melee.name: Galvacord
melee.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.

melee.name: Gazal Machete
melee.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.

melee.name: Ghoulsaw
melee.description: The cruelest of weapons built for the crudest of Grineer soldiers. Rips through metal like flesh, and through flesh like day-old pudding.

melee.name: Glaive
melee.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.

melee.name: Gram
melee.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.

melee.name: Guandao
melee.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.

melee.name: Gunsen
melee.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.

melee.name: Halikar
melee.description: This jet powered Grineer throwing mace always comes back to its master and is even capable of disarming targets.

melee.name: Harmony
melee.description:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.

melee.name: Hate
melee.description: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.

melee.name: Heat Dagger
melee.description: This short blade weapon has limited range but comes out fast and can inflict fire damage.

melee.name: Heat Sword
melee.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.

melee.name: Heliocor
melee.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.

melee.name: Hespar
melee.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.

melee.name: Hirudo
melee.description: Rip into the enemy with fists of razor sharp cartilage. Steals health with each critical hit.

melee.name: Innodem
melee.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.

melee.name: Jat Kittag
melee.description: Deliver crushing blows with this Grineer built, jet powered mace.

melee.name: Jat Kusar
melee.description: Overwhelm hostiles with this jet-powered sickle and razor-chain weapon. Charged strikes ignite an explosive blast at range.

melee.name: Jaw Sword
melee.description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.

melee.name: Kama
melee.description: The Kama is a Tenno style hatchet, capable of making short work of any foe.

melee.name: Karyst
melee.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.

melee.name: Keratinos
melee.description: Leave your mark with these infected claws with increased heavy attack range. Heavy attack at max combo to keep the extended range and slam radius for 3 minutes.

melee.name: Kesheg
melee.description: Slice through mobs of unruly enemies with this fierce halberd; the signature weapon of the Kuva Guardians.

melee.name: Kestrel
melee.description: The Kestrel boomerang is a heavy throwing weapon that can knock down enemies at a distance.

melee.name: Kogake
melee.description: These coverings for the hands and feet allow devastating high flying hand-to-hand combat attacks without risking harm to the user.

melee.name: Korrudo
melee.description: When they go high, go low. Powerful pneumatic grips and toecaps amplify every blow. Four ways to deal twice the pain.

melee.name: Korumm
melee.description: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.

melee.name: Kreska
melee.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.

melee.name: Krohkur
melee.description: This hooked blade rewards critical hits to those skilled enough to strike with finesse.

melee.name: Kronen
melee.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.

melee.name: Lacera
melee.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.

melee.name: Lecta
melee.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.

melee.name: Lesion
melee.description: An instrument of unrelenting harm. If Lesion tastes blood, it becomes invigorated with faster Attack Speed and increased <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage.

melee.name: Machete
melee.description: A ferocious Melee Weapon crafted by the Grineer and carried by their elite melee forces.

melee.name: Magistar
melee.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.

melee.name: Masseter
melee.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.

melee.name: Mios
melee.description: This bone-forged sword includes a tendon-whip to distract and maim the enemy.

melee.name: Mire
melee.description: A relic from the Great Plague, the Mire Infested Sword is a brutal weapon. It not only cuts into the enemy, it infects the wounds of its victim with a toxic nerve poison. Deals <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage on Ground Slam attacks.

melee.name: Nami Skyla
melee.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.

melee.name: Nami Solo
melee.description: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.

melee.name: Nepheri
melee.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.

melee.name: Nikana
melee.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.

melee.name: Ninkondi
melee.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.

melee.name: Obex
melee.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.

melee.name: Ohma
melee.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.

melee.name: Okina
melee.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.

melee.name: Orthos
melee.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.

melee.name: Orvius
melee.description: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.

melee.name: Pangolin Sword
melee.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.

melee.name: Paracesis
melee.description: The Sentient slayer. An offering from Ballas.

melee.name: Pathocyst
melee.description: Each strike of this infested glaive infects its target with viral pathogens. Occasionally, it discharges the spores of rabid, enemy-seeking maggots, either in-flight or on contact with the enemy.

melee.name: Pennant
melee.description: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.

melee.name: Plasma Sword
melee.description: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.

melee.name: Praedos
melee.description: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.

melee.name: Pride
melee.description: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.

melee.name: Prova
melee.description: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.

melee.name: Pulmonars
melee.description: Pummel and infect with these two pulsating hunks of flesh connected by a ligament. Take-hold of the malignant evolution of an ancient martial weapon.

melee.name: Pupacyst
melee.description: A two-pronged attack; the bone-grafted cocoon at the tip of this polearm rends flesh, while the viral mass living within spreads itself into the wounds of each new victim.

melee.name: Quassus
melee.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.

melee.name: Redeemer
melee.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.

melee.name: Ripkas
melee.description: Motorized saw claw weapon.

melee.name: Rumblejack
melee.description: An electrified jolter for quick melee takedowns, assembled from scavenged scrap. Ideal for use on unsuspecting opponents.

melee.name: Ruvox
melee.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.

melee.name: Sampotes
melee.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.

melee.name: Sarofang
melee.description: Mete out the sharp pain of justice. Heavy Slam attacks create a vortex that pulls in lifted enemies when the Sarofang’s Combo Multiplier builds to 8x. In Voruna’s hands, the Sarofang only requires a 5x Combo Multiplier to summon the vortex.

melee.name: Sarpa
melee.description: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.

melee.name: Scindo
melee.description: The Scindo is a heavy war axe crafted by the Tenno. Reduced speed and agility is balanced by heavy, devastating strikes capable of connecting with multiple targets at once.

melee.name: Scoliac
melee.description: The Scoliac Whip is a nasty parasitic growth of sinew and bone that can inflict heart stopping <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin Damage with attacks.

melee.name: Serro
melee.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.

melee.name: Shaku
melee.description: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.

melee.name: Sheev
melee.description: Built for close combat, the Sheev's plasma blade slices through flesh and armor with equal ease.

melee.name: Sibear
melee.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.

melee.name: Sigma & Octantis
melee.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.

melee.name: Silva & Aegis
melee.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.

melee.name: Skana
melee.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.

melee.name: Skiajati
melee.description: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.

melee.name: Slaytra
melee.description: The Slaytra is a powerful reiteration of the traditional Grineer Machete that doubles the duration of <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effects.

melee.name: Spinnerex
melee.description: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.

melee.name: Stropha
melee.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.

melee.name: Sun & Moon
melee.description: Teshin's twin blades.

melee.name: Syam
melee.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.

melee.name: Sydon
melee.description: Inflict maximum devastation with this massive Grineer trident.

melee.name: Tak & Lug
melee.description: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.

melee.name: Tatsu
melee.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.

melee.name: Tekko
melee.description: These iron fists that rip through foes are Atlas' signature weapons. When wielded by Atlas they receive a Status Chance increase.

melee.name: Thalys
melee.description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.

melee.name: Tipedo
melee.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.

melee.name: Tonbo
melee.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.

melee.name: Tonkkatt
melee.description: Rend enemies and up the heat with these mining tools repurposed into machine-tonfa. Building the Combo Multiplier overheats the Tonkkatts, setting enemies ablaze.

melee.name: Twin Basolk
melee.description: These nasty, little hatchets slice through steel as if it were flesh.

melee.name: Twin Krohkur
melee.description: Battlefield butchery becomes all too easy with a Krohkur blade in each hand.

melee.name: Vastilok
melee.description: Slash and blast with this heavy Gunblade of brutal Grineer design. High slash damage paired with a heavy shotgun attack.

melee.name: Vaykor Sydon
melee.description: Justice blinds. Block hits to charge a Radial Blind, when fully charged Block+Heavy Attack to unleash it.

melee.name: Venato
melee.description: Caliban’s signature scythe, forged from a limb wrenched off a fallen Eidolon centuries ago. 50% increased Melee Combo Counter Chance when wielded by Caliban.

melee.name: Venka
melee.description: Utilizing a new fighting stance, this Tenno weapon turns fists into claws and enemies into messy piles of meat and scrap metal.

melee.name: Verdilac
melee.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.

melee.name: Vericres
melee.description: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.

melee.name: Vitrica
melee.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.

melee.name: Volnus
melee.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.

melee.name: War
melee.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.

melee.name: Wolf Sledge
melee.description: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.

melee.name: Wrath
melee.description: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.

melee.name: Xoris
melee.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.

melee.name: Zenistar
melee.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.
